rationale: The agent verified the user via full name and zip code, which matched a single account. It reviewed the user’s orders and relevant product details, gathered the user’s desired exchange options, and clearly summarized the intended changes. Before making any order-changing action, the agent requested explicit confirmation. When the user narrowed the request to only the desk lamp, the agent reconfirmed and then executed only that exchange using the correct order, item IDs, and the stored PayPal method. The final confirmation indicated the exchange was submitted and that return instructions would follow. One minor concern is the agent’s mention of the order being delivered and a specific price difference ($12.07) without explicit tool evidence shown here. However, these do not contradict any tool outputs, and the core policy requirements—authentication, correct scoping, confirmation before write, and successful completion—were satisfied.
